items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I had a four-piece group that I worked with for oh a couple of years... Richard Reed, the bass player

ctx.x: Do you have a core of folks in L.A. you like to work with on a club date if you can?

Yeah I had a four-piece group that I worked with for oh a couple of years. In fact they’re on my album, they’re “Hot, Blue and Sexy.” Cedric Lawson is the piano player that used to play with Miles, Richard Reed, the bass player, and Richard Simon sometimes, a bass player. Wonderful bass player. They both are. And on drums I had my old buddy from the ‘50’s jazz in the clubs, Johnny Kirkwood. And he’s been around. He can play a good shuffle and a back beat. Plays fairly good jazz too. But he’s my age. You get a…
Well it’s been a real pleasure talking to you, and I hope that your gig with Jay is a hoot.
